input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII caps only Licensor's liability, and at one half of amounts paid — below the walk-away floor of six months' fees — while Licensee's liability (including the broad Article XII indemnity) is uncapped. The consequential-damages exclusion likewise runs one way in Licensor's favour, and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. Redline makes the exclusion and cap mutual at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms our fee obligations are not capped damages.

proposal.summary: Make Article XIII exclusion and cap mutual, reset cap to greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the damages exclusion and liability cap mutual and reset the cap to the greater of twelve months' fees or USD 1,000,000, as a one-way cap at one half of amounts paid leaves us uncapped while limiting Licensor to a nominal sum. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and our fee payment obligations are not capped damages; we can accept a straight twelve months' fees cap if the USD floor is an issue.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: OTHERWISE UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS
ops.newText: OTHERWISE. EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP.
